subject.title: feat(gateway): accept WebSocket request trace context

question: Should OpenClaw make per-request W3C traceparent propagation a supported Gateway WebSocket protocol feature and generated native-client contract?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but it expands the durable public Gateway protocol rather than repairing an established broken contract.

options.title: Sponsor the protocol field
options.body: Accept the optional request-scoped traceparent contract after real authenticated-session proof and a green current-head validation run.

options.title: Defer public protocol expansion
options.body: Keep tracing correlation behind an existing supported integration path until Gateway owners choose a stable client-facing contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the protocol field
recommendation.body: Accept the optional request-scoped traceparent contract after real authenticated-session proof and a green current-head validation run.

likelyOwner.person: gateway and diagnostics area owner unresolved
likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Gateway protocol ownership and the diagnostic-tracing subsystem.
